talks.abstract: This talk walks through how our team approached usability testing at scale over the past year. No prior experience is needed, but familiarity with the basics helps. Expected audience: about 33 participants.
talks.title: Lessons from usability testing at scale in production

talks.abstract: A hands-on look at vector databases, with code and real measurements. The session ends with a checklist attendees can apply on Monday. Expected audience: about 26 participants.

talks.abstract: We share the mistakes we made with cost-aware warehousing and how we fixed them. Expect concrete numbers, a few failure stories and an open-source companion repo. Organizers of past editions told us to plan for around 90 people.
